state_implementation: One shared state object; native anchors; source dialog preserves state and restores focus; presentation snapshot preserves selectors/details/scroll. Source period independent from forecast period.

source_binding.P02: exact d9486f1 source export; no physical-seat admission
source_binding.cities: 17 sealed Stage A packages from frozen root intake;135 programmes/148hypotheses
source_binding.P10: 128 capacity-only conditions; actual P09 bridge null

result_import.entry: replay.py --results-commit EXACT_ARTIFACT_SHA --results-path GIT_PATH, RW.load(envelope), local JSON import. Artifact commit may differ from producer payload commit; no self-referential SHA required.

evaluation_fields.label: real programme title
evaluation_fields.scenario_label: precomputed scenario label, not confidence interval

mapping.period_delta_precomputed: result.delta_summary for 24months; result.delta_annual for selected year

gates: same external scenario/resource/future horizon for KEEP
same programme/version/scope/evaluation mode/market-choice-cost scope for scenario comparison
result_import.trust_boundary: UI checks structure and supplied acceptance marker. Coordinator must verify exact SHA/manifest and release gates F01–F06; no claim of cryptographic acceptance or economic validation from upload.
no_computation: no financial model; producer aggregates only
result_import.missing_or_error: Unknown/null displays as unavailable; malformed import reports one error, prior valid state retained; unsupported scenario never enabled as result
result_import.number2_gate: release_gates.F07 must equal ACCEPTED and strategy must map by evaluation_id; P15 verifies compatible whole-business bridge; no rank/date inferred from regional programme
result_import.resource_monthly: Optional accepted evaluation.resource_monthly rows: month,aircraft_variant,transferred,entered_service,project_available,reserve,crew_maintenance_status; display only, no tail construction
result_import.comparison_group: Optional accepted comparison_group_id permits changed input versions within a validated experiment; always preserve programme/version/fleet scope/evaluation mode/period/affected scope
compatible_payloads: P12 full compare field structure without allocation/event payload in UI
P09_UI_PROJECTION preserving exact used numbers/null/status/context/evaluation links

projection.projection_contract: Объект P09: version,jsonpaths,hash convention,audit/replay; producer-owned exact path mapping. После получения sealed P09 path mapping сверить до binding.
may_omit: other full compare fields not displayed
projection.precision: Числа/null и инварианты копируются точно; округление только в Intl.NumberFormat видимой строки. Денежных/choice агрегатов в JS нет.
projection.full_results: gzip финалистов/основных выводов; остальные с sourcefullresultSHA256 и повторяемым replay
projection.acceptance: Формат и supplied coordinator marker не являются независимой эмпирической/экономической/операционной приёмкой.

result_import.binding_status: OPEN: ожидает sealed P09 projection contract+data+coordinator acceptance

delivery.local: Single self-contained HTML; no remote fonts/scripts/assets required

acceptance_boundary: Working UI skeleton with real source evidence; not acceptance of integrated programme, allocation, dispatch, profitability, number2 strategy or two-minute presentation
root_approval: Q-P09-UI01: компактная UI projection вместо110MB full compare на оценку
